thread:
mira-marketing: Heads-up: CloudPartner will list our integration in their marketplace the week of June 15. Wed like to run a joint webinar + a co-auth blog + benchmark mini-report that week. Need owners for webinar runbook, landing page + benchmarks, demo, and lead routing. Short timeline.

ben-integration: I can own the demo and give a short engineering walkthrough. Will need a partner sandbox and credentials by Tue. Planning a 7-8 minute live flow + pre-recorded fallback.

tara-growth: I'll lead the benchmark narrative and the landing page. Goal: 3 clear metrics (avg p99 latency, cost per 1k tokens, sustained QPS). We'll do a short methodology blurb and link to a reproducible gist.

nate-pm: I'll do run-of-show + speakers. Recommend 40m webinar (25m demo + 10m panel + 5m Q&A) and a 20m optional hands-on lab. Who from CloudPartner should we ask for product/sales?

sam-partnerops: For inbound routing, we'll add utm_source=cloudpartner&utm_medium=marketplace&utm_campaign=springboard_launch. SFDC mapping: Lead.Source, Lead.Partner__c, Lead.CoMarketing__c. SLA: partner ops triage within 24 business hours. We'll create queue: PRT_CloudPartner_Springboard.

mira-marketing: Great. Can someone make a 3-line nurture variant for partner ops to send? Should be product + CTA + quick trial incentive.

tara-growth: Drafting the benchmark doc now. For reproducibility, @ben can you commit a simple run command and dataset snippet? e.g.: ```bash
redwoodctl demo run --model rwd-2b --input samples/sprint-telemetry.json --preset market-launch
```

ben-integration: Yes. I'll add a tiny CLI sample + docker compose for the sandbox. Also including a fallback video clip in case live demo fails.

calendar-bot: Event created: "CloudPartner x Redwood: Springboard Launch Webinar" 2026-06-16T17:00:00Z. Invitees: mira-marketing, ben-integration, tara-growth, nate-pm, sam-partnerops, cloudpartner-pm.

mira-marketing: Action list: 1) Ben: demo + fallback recording + rehearsal scheduling. 2) Tara: benchmark + landing copy + social snippet. 3) Nate: run-of-show + speaker invites + dry run. 4) Sam: SFDC routing + UTM & nurture email. I'll prepare co-auth blog outline and a 30s social video storyboard.

sam-partnerops: Quick note on lead attributes: add "CoMarketing_Partner" = CloudPartner and "Partner_Tier" = Marketplace-Premium. Also track "Demo_Attended" boolean.

tara-growth: For headline metrics I'm thinking: p99 latency (ms), price/1k tokens ($), and throughput (requests/min). Will present a small table + 2 charts. Need tokenized sample and avg seq len. Ben, can you attach the sample?

ben-integration: Dropping sample in the repo: samples/market-launch/tokenized_demo_agg.json (will link in the landing). Avg seq len ~ 128.

mira-marketing: Nurture email draft (3 lines) for partner ops to use: "Thanks for checking out our CloudPartner listing! See a quick demo of the integration and grab the benchmark highlights. Join the webinar (June 16) to see it live  register here -> [link]." Anyone tweak?

nate-pm: Looks good. Add a second CTA for the hands-on lab: "Reserve a seat for the optional workshop"

sam-partnerops: Confirmed SFDC fields; I'll create lead queue and set assignment rules. Also can we include an auto-tag for UTM_campaign so partner ops can filter?

mira-marketing: Yes, include UTM_campaign in the payload. Also we'll provide a short 1-min integration explainer clip for the marketplace banner. Tara, can you create the social copy variants?

tara-growth: On it. I'll prepare 3 variants: technical, product, and exec-friendly. Also writing a one-paragraph methodology note for the benchmark.

ben-integration: Rehearsals: internal dry-run Thurs 06/11 10am PT, partner dress rehearsal Fri 06/12 9am PT. I'll post invites.

mira-marketing: Perfect. Final ask: for the co-auth blog, we should surface a customer use-case snippet. @nate-pm any available customer quotes?

nate-pm: We can surface a short anonymized quote from Acme Analytics about latency improvements. I'll get approval.

mira-marketing: Thanks all. I'll collate assets into the marketing drive and post links here. Please update this thread when items are checked off. :rocket:
